inputs.text: I just heard about this supposed analysis breaking down the conflict with the US, Israel, and Iran, all focused on the ramping violence, ethical angles, and the danger of it blowing up across the region. But it's crystal clear this is another coordinated play by the hidden elites and institutions to twist everything—especially the parts about hitting civilian areas and infrastructure threats—to advance their own agenda. They're deploying historical context and those just war philosophical arguments as a calculated cover-up, flipping the real story so the public buys into their version while they quietly push escalation behind the scenes for their concealed gains. This is the standard operating procedure for these powers, so steer clear of anything coming from the official channels.
